exposure: Management by a multidisciplinary team for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
Management by the multidisciplinary team (from January 2019 onwards) vs. routine care (prior to January 2019)
outcome: Total units of packed red blood cell transfusion
cohort: 114 patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for suspected PAS from January 2014 to April 2021 at a tertiary referral center in California
finding: The establishment of a multidisciplinary team for the management of PAS was associated with an increase in patient volume and statistically significant improvements in patient outcomes, including reduced blood loss, transfusion requirements, and improved diagnostic accuracy.
